title: Remove fixture and resident-root boundaries
objective: Feed no-oracle regulator completion from the live unit bridge 2x7 transform and exact-polynomial embedding rebuild, retaining fixture data only as an external differential oracle

oracles: Live resident owners and exact polynomial embedding; compact fixture only as external differential oracle

handoff.summary: Removes the compact fixture and resident-root inputs from authority construction: the 2x7 map now comes from live unit bridge prepare/getfu provenance, exact units come from live resident owners, and the embedding is rebuilt from the exact polynomial and integral basis. The compact fixture is used only for an out-of-band differential assertion.
risks: Internal correspondence still assumes the pinned PARI heuristic/acceptance policy and does not certify unit saturation.
next_steps: Integrate this follow-up before treating the no-oracle completion as a durable terminal stage.
